items.title: Glarity - Summary for Google/YouTube with ChatGPT
items.summary: An open-source extension that shows AI-generated summaries next to Google search results and on YouTube videos. It can also summarise other web pages, PDFs and emails, and adds side-by-side translation and web content Q&A.

items.title: Writely
items.summary: A browser extension that brings AI writing help to editors on any web page. It uses OpenAI's GPT models to draft text such as emails and articles, and it can also help with translation and reading. It is positioned as an alternative to Notion AI.

items.title: YouTube Summary with ChatGPT
items.summary: A simple Manifest V3 extension that shows a video's transcript on YouTube and helps you get an AI summary of it. A button copies a ready-made prompt and opens ChatGPT, where you paste it to see the summary.
